findings.note: NOT FOUND in this corpus. The corpus holds 60,483 United States Code sections; a miss does NOT prove the section does not exist — coverage varies by corpus. Verify against the official source before telling anyone a citation is wrong.

warnings: 1 statute/rule citation(s) were NOT FOUND in the corpus that would hold them. That is not proof they are wrong: corpus coverage varies, and each finding carries its own coverage note and nearby sections. Verify each against the official source before filing, and do not tell anyone a section does not exist on this alone.
statutes.note: Statutes, regulations and court rules found in the document, checked against the corpus that holds each one (kind-scoped: a rule cite is never verified against a statute row). Quoted statutory language attached to a case citation is compared with the sections the document names (quote_checks[].statute_quote); statute text quoted under its own cite is listed as quoted_text and not compared yet.
